subject: Promo allocation for Alpha Incubator cohort - discount & credit packaging?
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna@alpha-incubator.com>

Cc: partnerships@alpha-incubator.com

Subject: Promo allocation for Alpha Incubator cohort - discount & credit packaging?

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed by the latency numbers and the dedicated deployment options. We're putting together the pitch for our next founder cohort and want to confirm how Redwood's promotional credits would work if we: 1) include the Redwood free credit as a cohort perk, and 2) offer a short-term discount to cohort teams that convert to Reserved/Dedicated during month 2.

Two specific asks:
- Can Redwood add a one-off cohort top-up (additional credits) that are redeemable only within 90 days? We typically give credits that must be used during the program window.
- Is there flexibility on a temporary 20% discount to onboarding Dedicated seats for teams that commit before the cohort demo day? If so, is that a commercial exception or part of the standard promo playbook?

I've attached a short SOW and our expected usage profile for the cohort (10 teams, light dev usage week 1-2, spike on demo day). Happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Anna Lopez
Head of Partnerships
Alpha Incubator
attachments: Alpha_Cohort_SOW.pdf, usage_projection.csv

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Anna Lopez <anna@alpha-incubator.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-04T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo allocation for Alpha Incubator cohort - discount & credit packaging?

Hi Anna — great to hear, and thanks for the materials.

Short answers up front:
- Cohort top-up credits: yes, we can issue time-bound promotional/top-up credits that expire (we normally set 60–90 days). We can make them restricted to the account created from the program invite.
- 20% temp discount to Dedicated onboarding: this is typically an exception (Reserved/Dedicated conversion discounts are handled case-by-case). I can route an exception request — need a little detail for approvals.

Actions I need from you to accelerate:
1) Confirm whether credits should be usable by individual team sub-accounts or pooled under Alpha Incubator master billing.
2) Confirm target conversion volume (how many teams likely to convert in month 2) and expected committed peak QPS/throughput per converted team (so we can size Dedicated seats and quantify unit economics).

If you can send that by EOD, I'll start the internal exception note and include the SOW and usage file you sent. If pooled billing is fine, we can also provide a coupon flow that Alpha redeems and then distributes.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Startup Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Grace — forwarding Anna's ask. Quick thoughts from RevOps/sales side:

- If Alpha wants pooled master billing, that reduces friction (we control redemption scope). That also makes it easier to attach a 90-day top-up with tracking.
- The 20% Dedicated onboarding discount is borderline for standard playbook; ought to be an approved one-off for strategic partners. Suggest approval with a cap: 20% off onboarding fees for up to 5 teams per cohort, plus a one-time top-up of 150k tokens per team (expires 90 days).

Constraints to note for ops:
- We need confirmed usage projections (Grace asked for this) so infra can reserve burst capacity; Dedicated seat pricing impact will depend on expected peak seq lengths and concurrency.
- Finance needs the deal qualifier: is this MDF/commit backed or purely promotional? If it's promo-only, we should require a small refundable commit (or a conversion SLA) to protect unit economics.

If you want me to draft the Exception Request doc and an approval memo for Markus, I can. CC'ing Markus to expedite.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Growth
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Promo allocation for Alpha Incubator cohort - discount & credit packaging?

Thanks Ben and Grace — read the thread. High level: Alpha Incubator looks strategically valuable (strong funnel, pipeline of follow-on deals). Approve a limited commercial carveout with the following conditions:

1) 20% onboarding discount approved for up to 5 teams per cohort, valid for conversions within 45 days of cohort start.
2) One-time top-up credits: 150,000 tokens per converted team, expiring 90 days. Credits must be allocated to team-specific sub-accounts and tracked via the HubSpot company record (deal ACCT-9321).
3) Require a minimum refundable trial commit of $500 credited on redemption to reduce abuse. If the cohort sponsor requests pooled billing without commit, limit to a max of 3 pooled redemptions.
4) RevOps to add a custom coupon code and a usage gating rule so ops can monitor demo-day spike usage.

Ben — please draft the approval memo and exception ticket for Finance & RevOps. Grace — once Ben has the memo, send a breakup email to Anna confirming the approved terms and the process for redemption.

Markus Klein
VP Sales Operations & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi Anna — quick update and next steps: great news, we've approved a limited exception for Alpha Incubator. Summary of approved terms below (finalized in writing once legal signs off):

- 20% onboarding discount to Dedicated seats for up to 5 teams that convert within 45 days of cohort start.
- One-time top-up: 150,000 tokens per converted team, expires 90 days after issuance. Top-ups will be assigned to team-specific sub-accounts (not pooled).
- We require a refundable $500 trial commit at redemption to protect against misuse; if Alpha requests pooled billing without a commit, we can allow it for a maximum of 3 pooled redemptions only.

Next steps:
1) Ben will circulate the internal approval memo + exception ticket to Finance & RevOps (for coupon creation and gating rules).
2) I'll send you a redemption guide and the custom coupon code once RevOps provisions it (target timeline: 2 business days).
3) Please confirm whether you prefer sub-account invites now or after the coupon is ready. If you send me the list of likely converting teams, we can pre-provision accounts.

Thanks — excited to partner on demo day.
